stills.title: The Blacksmith of Fate
stills.description: A stern older man with gray hair sits centered at a stone anvil, both hands resting on its surface. He wears a simple tunic with a glowing black orb covered in white symbols on his chest, while ethereal, translucent angelic wings with mathematical and alchemical symbols float behind him.

stills.title: Horned Witch with Scroll
stills.description: A black silhouette of a horned female figure with pink tears sits on a swirling green cloth, reading an unrolled green scroll. The surreal night scene features blue swirling ribbons with glowing symbols, a flowering yellow tree branch above, and three crystal orbs below containing miniature scenes of a moonlit beach with two figures.

stills.title: Demoness by the Lake
stills.description: A black silhouette of a horned female demon with glowing red eyes sits on a rock in dark water, holding a flowering branch. The surreal scene features floating crystal pillars, glowing orbs containing figures, koi fish, lotus flowers, pink clouds, and multiple blue eyes in a cracked night sky with a pink sunset horizon.

stills.title: The Weaver of Runes
stills.description: A translucent hooded figure weaves glowing runes into fabric on an ornate wooden loom inside a dark stone chamber. The workspace features an open book of diagrams, scattered tools, a lit candle, and t-shirts with symbols hanging on graffiti-covered brick walls under an aurora-lit night sky visible through arched windows.

stills.title: Horned Muse by the Ruins
stills.description: A silhouetted female figure with large curved horns sits on a moss-covered stone ledge, extending her hand toward glowing yellow cherry blossom branches. Behind her are ancient Greek temple ruins overgrown with vines, set against a swirling twilight sky filled with floating bubbles containing silhouetted couples, black birds, and scattered pink petals over reflective water.

stills.title: Demon Reading Under Cherry Tree
stills.description: A black silhouette demon with horns and a long tail sits on a green-draped table, one hand touching an open spellbook with glowing symbols. Three floating picture frames hover above, each containing silhouettes of figures in different scenes, while a flowering yellow cherry blossom branch extends across a swirling blue sky filled with stylized eyes.

stills.title: Witch Under Cherry Tree
stills.description: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a black silhouetted witch with horns and glowing blue patterns, seated on a glowing green root structure. She holds a dripping pink orb containing a couple silhouette against a sunset, with a large black bird perched on a pink cherry blossom branch above her, surrounded by swirling starry skies, floating orbs, butterflies, and pink liquid dripping onto the text 'STASIS DO NOT BREAK THE NOTE'.

stills.title: Horned Muse by the Pond
stills.description: A blue-skinned horned female figure with a long tail stands in a surreal pond, holding a sheet of dripping musical notation. She reaches toward a white butterfly as black birds perch on a gnarled tree filled with glowing orbs and a large sphere showing two silhouetted lovers.

stills.title: Surreal Skull Symphony
stills.description: A vibrant surreal scene inside a cracked purple room with a large broken ceiling revealing a stormy sea with ships and lightning. A giant green skull wearing red glasses sits with a white cat on its shoulder reading sheet music, while a blue-haired mermaid goddess floats above emitting turquoise energy and small human figures; below, two skeletal grim reapers in black robes play a red spiral drum and a purple saxophone amid flying musical notes and papers.

stills.title: Skull Wizard Cat Concert
stills.description: A giant green skull wearing red sunglasses sits on a snowy wooden stage with its mouth open, revealing colorful objects inside. A skeletal cat wizard in ornate robes and glasses floats above, holding a glowing turquoise staff amid swirling purple magic and ghostly figures, while two skeleton musicians play saxophone and drums at the base.

stills.title: Skull Ballet Despair
stills.description: A surreal festive scene features a giant green skull with red sunglasses and blood dripping from its mouth, exhaling purple smoke with musical notes. In a snowy room decorated with Christmas trees and ornaments, multiple dancing skeletons in pink tutus perform ballet, one playing a guitar while another reads a large black book titled 'DESPAIR'.

stills.title: Ballet of Desire
stills.description: In a dark, theatrical backstage setting with heavy curtains and film reels, a ballerina in a pink tutu dances with a glowing blue holographic male figure projecting from an old movie projector. In the foreground, an open magical book titled 'Desire' emits purple smoke and light, while another ballerina lies motionless on the snowy ground beside a fallen red pointe shoe.

stills.title: Necromancer's Forest Ritual
stills.description: A blue-skinned necromancer in ornate green armor and helmet kneels in a snowy forest clearing, casting a spell from a glowing purple book with swirling magical energy. A large blue and pink monstrous creature with tentacle hair and a giant pink flower on its back floats above, while two zombie-like figures stand in the background and another defeated pink creature lies on the ground.

stills.title: Psychedelic Ballet Dancers
stills.description: Three blue-skinned ballerinas in pink and teal tutus perform a surreal, intertwined dance pose. They are covered in dripping colorful paint against a cosmic background of swirling purple, teal and orange nebulae, stars, lightning, and floating cannabis leaves.

stills.title: Cosmic Ballet Dream
stills.description: Two ballerinas in green and pink tutus dance gracefully in a swirling cosmic vortex, one holding a broom with golden sparks. A green dragon, blue cat head, green fish, and colorful planets orbit around them on a vibrant geometric tiled floor.

stills.title: Surreal Clockwork Dreamscape
stills.description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts a skeletal grim reaper in a purple robe with gears and clocks, holding a large ornate clock face with a green winged elephant emerging from it. Below, a witch on a broomstick flies through a swirling vortex of hot air balloons, pocket watches, stars, and geometric patterns under a radiant sun with a cosmic colorful sky.

stills.title: Grim Reaper on Pier
stills.description: A skeletal Grim Reaper in a purple robe stands on a wooden pier over colorful swirling water, holding a bloody handgun in one hand and a large ornate clock in the other. The surreal sky features a blue dragon, a scythe-wielding grim reaper silhouette, a green skeleton elephant on a broomstick, multiple hot air balloons, and traditional East Asian buildings floating in the water below.

stills.title: Surreal Desert Eye Vision
stills.description: A giant stylized human eye floats in a purple sky above a desert landscape, with a red mouse inside its pupil and green vines extending downward. Below, a woman in a flowing red robe and headscarf walks through sand dunes surrounded by transparent bubbles containing smaller red mice and desert scenes, with cacti visible in the background.

stills.title: Surreal Desert Dreamscape
stills.description: A robed figure with a red backpack and mouse-like tail stands on a sand dune holding a small glowing object. In the foreground is a colorful geodesic dome with dripping paint and a glowing green puddle, while above floats a large cluster of transparent bubbles containing miniature desert scenes with cacti and figures, all beneath a giant red eye in the sky.

stills.title: Surreal Mosaic Muse
stills.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman's face and upper body composed of colorful mosaic tiles, with her mouth open as if singing or shouting. Her flowing psychedelic hair contains white horses, flowers, and swirls, while a spiral vortex of multicolored tiles emanates from her neck downward; to the right, a mosaic dog-like creature stands on a platform as glowing orbs project from her mouth toward it.

stills.title: Ethereal Mystic Portal
stills.description: A luminous pale-skinned woman with white hair and floral patterns on her body emerges from a reflective mosaic floor, gazing upward. She is surrounded by a large circular astrological chart with a teal spiral center, a blue horned demon figure, swimming teal fish, pink cherry blossoms, glowing green orbs, and a greyhound-like dog wearing an ornate ruff collar.

stills.title: Veiled Sorceress Ritual
stills.description: A hooded pregnant sorceress in a flowing black robe stands barefoot on a dark tiled platform adorned with glowing symbols, constellations, and lotus flowers. She raises her hands in a magical gesture as three ghostly hands emerge from below holding orbs, while dark birds fly around her and a large cracked moon with multiple eyes looms in the starry sky above a swirling cosmic portal.

stills.title: Mystic Sorceress Ritual
stills.description: A hooded female sorceress with pale skin and white hair stands centrally with arms outstretched, wearing a dark blue robe adorned with celestial symbols. She is surrounded by magical elements including glowing flowers, flying birds, floating runes, crystal orbs with clocks, a large all-seeing eye in a swirling cosmic portal above, and a full moon with a tower in a ruined fantasy landscape.

stills.title: Obese Armored Sorcerer
stills.description: A massively obese man with pale skin and numerous tattoos sits on a dark throne, wearing black spiked armor with purple accents and a golden book crown. He is surrounded by floating magical papers, lit candles, and arcane symbols in a fiery purple and orange cavernous setting.

stills.title: Armored Figure with Quill
stills.description: A large, overweight man in ornate dark metal armor and helmet sits on a massive burning book. He holds a large quill in one hand and a shield covered in heraldic symbols in the other, with an open book resting on his lap. The background is a swirling purple vortex filled with floating text and a hanging scale labeled 'JUSTICE' dripping red liquid.

stills.title: Mystic Tree of Realms
stills.description: A massive, ancient tree with a glowing bulbous trunk and roots extending into a reflective pool stands centrally. Its branches bear colorful stained-glass leaves, while a luminous castle floats in the starry sky above, surrounded by auroras, waterfalls, birds, and ethereal figures.

stills.title: Ethereal Tree of Life
stills.description: A massive, gnarled white tree with stained glass leaves dominates a cosmic night sky filled with aurora borealis. A cloaked figure with a flowing blue and gold robe floats above an ornate circular fountain, from which waterfalls cascade while the tree's roots form a dragon-like mouth breathing light.

stills.title: Stained Glass Tree Portal
stills.description: A powerful older woman with long braided gray hair and flowing purple robes floats above a circular cosmic pool, her hands extended as she summons or controls the scene. Behind her a massive ancient tree with a dragon-like head rises into a swirling sky of colorful stained glass patterns, with multiple waterfalls cascading down into the pool that reflects a vibrant nebula and a reaching hand.

stills.title: Floating Shaman in Aurora
stills.description: A woman in a shimmering green and gold patterned bodysuit floats upside down in the center of a surreal cosmic scene, arms outstretched. Below her is a glowing circular pool with waterfalls cascading over rocky cliffs into a dark void filled with glowing particles, ghostly figures, twisted trees, and vibrant aurora borealis lights.

stills.title: Aurora Spirit in Pond
stills.description: A large, heavyset purple-skinned woman with a rounded belly stands barefoot in a dark reflective pond, her body covered in glowing white star-like dots. She is surrounded by twisted glowing tree roots, lotus flowers, two white birds in flight, and a dramatic green and pink aurora borealis in the starry night sky, with her dark shadow cast on the water.

stills.title: Diver at Cosmic Pool
stills.description: An overweight woman in a purple swimsuit and red swim cap sits on the edge of a high diving board, looking down into an indoor swimming pool. The pool water features a swirling cosmic vortex with a silhouetted diver at its glowing center, surrounded by colorful nebulae patterns under a purple-lit skylight.

stills.title: Diving into the Pool
stills.description: A large overweight man wearing purple swim briefs and a black swim cap is captured mid-air in a belly flop dive above a glowing swimming pool at dusk. The pool water shows concentric ripples and a clear underwater reflection of the man, with a diving board, pool noodles, and a single swim fin visible.

stills.title: Diving Woman in Pool
stills.description: An overweight middle-aged woman with dark curly hair is captured mid-air as she jumps into a swimming pool. She wears a purple one-piece swimsuit with yellow patterns and has a joyful expression on her face.

stills.title: Poolside Plunge
stills.description: Two overweight people, a man and a woman, are captured mid-jump into a glowing swimming pool at night. The man wears blue swim trunks while the woman wears a dark purple one-piece swimsuit, both surrounded by ripples, steam, and colorful neon reflections on the water.

stills.title: Poolside Argument
stills.description: Two large women stand in a swimming pool at night, arguing. The pale-skinned woman with a crown and 'I AM THAT GIRL' written on her chest jumps angrily while pointing, facing a dark-skinned woman in a purple swimsuit with 'NO YOU AIN'T' on her chest who gestures back.

stills.title: Chained Guardian of the Flame
stills.description: A muscular dark-skinned man with a golden crown and heavy chains kneels in the center of a dark stone chamber. He holds a large ornate shield glowing with purple swirling magical energy while smoke rises from his mouth, surrounded by scattered gold coins, a broken hourglass, and falling yellow leaves.

stills.title: Weaver of Shadows
stills.description: A hooded figure kneels before a large wooden loom inside a gothic hall, weaving threads that form a glowing, fiery oval portal. On the stone floor in the foreground sits an hourglass, a butterfly on a wreath, an overturned bucket spilling red liquid, and a scroll with intricate patterns resting on the loom's base.

stills.title: Forging the Magic Anvil
stills.description: A hooded blacksmith stands at a stone base holding a hammer and parchment, looking up at a glowing blue crystal being forged on an anvil by a pair of tongs. Blue magical energy drips from the crystal and a floating arcane circle above, surrounded by flying blue birds against a wall covered in glowing runes and symbols.

stills.title: Cosmic Time Cauldron
stills.description: A large ornate cauldron floats in a cosmic void, glowing with golden light from within as blue liquid drips from its rim. Below it, three hooded spectral figures with clock faces for heads rise from swirling blue energy, surrounded by floating books, gears, hourglasses, and three celestial orbs in the starry sky above.

stills.title: Cosmic Forge Sorceress
stills.description: A blue-skinned sorceress with white markings stands behind a glowing anvil, channeling blue lightning-like energy from her hands into a key. She is surrounded by floating gears, an hourglass, cards, an open spellbook, coins, and mystical symbols in a ruined stone chamber under a swirling cosmic night sky filled with stars and nebulae.

stills.title: Demonic Organ in Ruins
stills.description: A dark blue demonic figure with horns and claws emerges from a large pipe organ set within a crumbling gothic stone archway. Blue flames and dripping liquid surround the chained instrument while an open book titled 'SATANIS' lies on the debris-strewn floor in front.

stills.title: Cuckoo Clock Surreal Nightmare
stills.description: A surreal painting depicts a melting wooden cuckoo clock with a large blue eye in its face and blue liquid dripping from its structure. Below, two hands emerge from rippling blue water, one with scaled blue skin and the other pale with a ring, reaching toward a large ornate blue key that hangs from the clock's mouth-like opening, which is filled with sharp teeth.

stills.title: Demonic Knight Forging
stills.description: A horned demonic knight in ornate red armor kneels inside a ruined gothic cathedral, hammering a glowing molten sword on an anvil. Blue and red fiery wings spread behind him as light streams from a large rose window above, illuminating ritual circles, an open spellbook, and scattered blood on the stone floor.

stills.title: Eclipse Goddess in Ruins
stills.description: A surreal scene depicts a pale female figure with glowing blue flame-like hair emerging from a broken stone sarcophagus entwined with thorny vines. Three black ravens with red dripping elements fly around a massive red and black solar eclipse in a dark, stormy sky above ancient ruined pillars and glowing green runic stones.

stills.title: Bound Prometheus Eclipse
stills.description: A surreal classical scene depicts a muscular male figure bound in glowing green vines lying on broken stone ruins, with blue energy emanating from his eyes and mouth. Two dark winged creatures fly above carrying chains of glowing blue symbols, set against a blood-red sky with a black eclipse sun, ancient Greek-style columns, a golden crystal formation, and a statue of a robed figure gesturing beside fiery braziers with floating runes.

stills.title: Demons Sharing Crystals
stills.description: A blue horned demon kneels on the left while a larger red horned demon kneels on the right, both holding and exchanging glowing yellow crystals and flowers in a dark fantasy setting. They are surrounded by green grass, purple mist, and a background of cracked blue stone walls with hanging red handprints.

stills.title: Demonic Forge Ritual
stills.description: A red demonic blacksmith with glowing green hair and horns stands at a glowing anvil in a dark ritual chamber, hammering a piece of metal. The scene features swirling red, green and blue energy vortexes above, patches of bright green grass growing from stone blocks, scattered red petals, an open book, and small demonic creatures on the stone floor.

stills.title: Demonic Blacksmith Forging
stills.description: A muscular demonic figure with green and red skin, flaming head, and large blue wings kneels while forging on a red anvil, holding a hammer and emitting red, green, and blue laser beams from his eyes. An open wooden door with purple light and smoky green-red clouds appears in the background, with scattered papers and coins on the ground.

stills.title: Cosmic Spellforge Ritual
stills.description: Three glowing humanoid figures in green, blue, and red stand back-to-back inside a swirling cauldron, their arms raised high to hold a green glowing chain descending from above. The dark starry sky is filled with floating papers, mathematical symbols, colorful light streaks, and handprints circling in a vortex around the central figures.

stills.title: Stasis Ritual
stills.description: Three golden humanoid figures sit in a decaying room. The central male figure holds an open book labeled STASIS while yellow liquid drips from his chest; he is flanked by two females, one with wild hair throwing glowing yellow particles and another with a long braid and circular patterns on her back.

stills.title: Golden Trinity in Alchemy
stills.description: A surreal painting depicts a three-headed golden figure with multiple arms, covered in text and symbols, seated in a large copper basin filled with molten gold that drips everywhere. The scene is set inside a stone chamber with walls covered in glowing alchemical and esoteric symbols, a skylight above casting radiant beams, and scattered papers on the floor.

stills.title: Yellow Crucible of Words
stills.description: A muscular, emaciated humanoid figure kneels inside a large bronze cauldron filled with thick, glowing yellow liquid. The figure holds an open black book with glowing yellow text while looking upward, as viscous yellow substance drips from a cracked stone arch above inscribed with runic text.

stills.title: Forging the Spell
stills.description: A surreal steampunk scene shows a mechanical dragon-like creature with bat wings perched on an anvil, its mouth open as it extrudes long strands of yellow pasta. Various tools including a hammer, chisel, and tongs float around it against cracked yellow walls with floating text and numbers.

stills.title: Mystic Library Grimoire
stills.description: An ancient open book with glowing magical circles and dripping golden liquid rests on a gnarled tree-root stand in a candlelit library. A hooded figure reads by a cracked arched window showing a sunset sky, while bookshelves, hanging lanterns, chains, and scattered papers fill the stone chamber.

stills.title: Mystic Rune Ritual
stills.description: A hooded figure in a brown robe kneels before a large ancient stone door covered in glowing runes, as molten orange light flows from the door's opening onto the cracked floor inscribed with magical symbols. The stone chamber contains scattered scrolls, an overturned pot spilling dark contents, and a small dish with rings, with a crescent moon visible through a high window against a twilight sky.

stills.title: Arcane Scribe at Work
stills.description: A hooded wizard in a starry blue robe sits at a slanted black desk, writing with a quill that emits green smoke onto glowing blue parchment. Floating above him are multiple burning magical scrolls and papers with symbols, set in a stone room with an aurora visible through the window.

stills.title: Mysterious Cloaked Figure
stills.description: A hooded figure in a flowing blue and purple cloak stands on the right side of a moss-covered stone bridge over reflective water. The dark, stormy sky features two celestial bodies, one dark and one glowing green, with lightning and swirling glowing petals surrounding the figure.

stills.title: Sorceress by Eclipse Lake
stills.description: A woman in a flowing blue and pink robe stands on a stone ledge overlooking a reflective lake, holding an open book and reaching toward floating magical books and cherry blossom petals. An eclipse shines in the twilight sky above, with its reflection in the water, while an open book and crystal orb rest on the ledge nearby.

stills.title: Mystic Anvil Forge
stills.description: A skeletal figure with crossed arms sits on a glowing purple crystal atop a large black anvil. The anvil rests in the center of a swirling purple vortex encircled by a glowing golden ring inscribed with runes, with floating books, moths, and a smoking rose above.

stills.title: Weaving Digital Destiny
stills.description: A surreal scene shows a human hand on the left holding a digital pen, interacting with an ornate mechanical loom that weaves a glowing golden infinity symbol. Ancient scrolls unfurl from the loom, dripping molten gold into a reflective pool below, while floating geometric polyhedra and ethereal smoke appear in the dark cosmic background.

stills.title: Cosmic Heart Ritual
stills.description: A pale hand wearing a glowing ring rests on the right edge of a large, ornate cosmic table filled with intricate astrological and alchemical symbols. Above the table floats a large crystalline heart structure containing a glowing galaxy, emitting purple smoke and surrounded by butterflies under a starry sky with aurora borealis and ancient stone arches.

stills.title: Astronomer with Celestial Globe
stills.description: A woman in a striped dress sits on a wooden stool with her back to the viewer, writing with a quill in an open book resting on a large ornate armillary sphere. The sphere has golden rings with inscriptions and a blue rod, with torn pages and red ink spilling from the book.

stills.title: Mystic Math Crystal
stills.description: A glowing crystal ball hovers above a dark chalkboard covered in colorful mathematical equations, formulas, and a radiating rainbow spectrum. A lit candle in a brass holder, scattered papers, a drafting compass, and lavender sprigs surround the board against a textured blue background.

stills.title: Spellforge Product
stills.description: A surreal night scene features a large tilted blackboard covered in glowing mathematical equations including 30x(f)^2 - y and integrals. A blue-skinned humanoid figure with white patterned head and multicolored wires extending from its body holds a quill, writing on the board as flames and sparks erupt from its surface. Torn pages with formulas and a wax seal float in the dark foreground.

stills.title: Abacus and Scroll Machine
stills.description: A girl with a long braid stands in a mystical room, holding an abacus while reaching toward a large mechanical device with gears that is unspooling a long scroll filled with equations. The walls and floor are covered in mathematical formulas, with an open book, candle, and scattered papers in the foreground and rows of small machines visible in the background.

stills.title: Mystical Equation Table
stills.description: A surreal scene shows a wooden table covered in scattered papers and parchments filled with complex mathematical equations and symbols. Three disembodied hands in different colors interact with the items: a blue hand holds a geometric shape at the top left, a purple hand writes with a quill at the bottom, and a golden hand holds a coin over a paper on the right. At the center sits a glowing glass orb containing a black rose, illuminated by a dramatic beam of light from above against a dark, starry background with floating scrolls and tablets.

stills.title: Vibrant Paint Splatter
stills.description: An abstract composition of colorful paint splatters and drips on a white surface. Bright yellows, greens, oranges, blues and pinks form organic shapes, bubbles, and flowing vertical drips across the canvas.

stills.title: Vibrant Paint Drip Abstract
stills.description: A dynamic abstract composition of vibrant, fluid paint splatters and thick drips flowing downward across a white surface. Bright overlapping colors form an energetic central mass with organic shapes, bubbles, and vertical streams in multiple hues.

stills.title: Vibrant Abstract Landscape
stills.description: A colorful surreal landscape painting featuring rolling green and yellow hills, stylized trees with rounded colorful foliage, and a bright winding path. Three horizontal white bars with circular cutouts overlay the center of the composition like a graphic interface element.

stills.title: Abstract Wine Bottle
stills.description: An abstract painting featuring a stylized wine bottle in the center, rendered with flat pink, orange, and white shapes against a background divided into soft pink on the left and muted blue tones on the right. Visible brushstrokes, drips, and geometric color blocks create a modern, fragmented composition.

stills.title: Desert Wanderer
stills.description: A solitary figure dressed in dark clothing stands in the middle of a vast desert, holding a long staff. Footprints and scattered rocks lead toward the figure across rolling pink and orange sand dunes under a uniform pale pink sky.

stills.title: Knight Facing Dragon
stills.description: A lone knight in shining armor and flowing red cape stands on a rocky cliff, sword raised towards a massive golden dragon looming in the misty sky above. The dragon has prominent horns and spines, with a hazy, smoky atmosphere and orange brushstroke accents filling the background.

stills.title: Crimson-haired Renaissance Woman
stills.description: A close-up portrait of a young woman with long, wavy, vibrant red-orange hair cascading over her right shoulder. She has fair skin with visible freckles on her chest, striking blue eyes, and wears an ornate off-the-shoulder teal gown with gold floral patterns, lace trim, and wooden bead details.

stills.title: Fiery Muse Portrait
stills.description: A digital painting of a beautiful woman with long, flowing orange-red hair looking to the side with a contemplative expression. Her bare shoulders and chest are visible with one hand resting near her collarbone, while a small silhouette of a warrior stands on a dark boat-like form across her torso against a warm abstract background with orange paint splatters.

stills.title: Crimson Figure on the Edge
stills.description: A lone figure in a flowing red robe sits on a rocky cliff edge, gazing toward a dramatic sky filled with swirling clouds of fiery orange, yellow, and teal. The foreground shows broken stone fragments under a painterly, atmospheric glow.

stills.title: Surreal Gathering Under Eclipse
stills.description: A surreal scene depicts five people in a dimly lit room with a large table covered in food, books, and objects. In the dramatic sky above, a giant glowing orange moon dominates a swirling vortex, with a floating figure, orbiting spheres, and a large black bird flying through clouds of smoke.

stills.title: Pink Alien on Mossy Rock
stills.description: A cute pink octopus-like alien with large black eyes and two antennae sits atop a dark moss-covered rock. The creature is surrounded by floating bright orange squares against a solid teal-green background.

stills.title: Octopus on Sunset Rock
stills.description: A large magenta octopus with big black eyes perches on a moss-covered rock in the foreground, overlooking a body of water. In the background is a city skyline with cranes and a bridge under a dramatic orange-red sunset sky dominated by a massive glowing yellow sun.

stills.title: Alien on Red Planet Peak
stills.description: A large white spherical alien creature with red polka dots, a single huge black eye, and multiple pink tentacles stands atop a rocky, moss-covered orange peak. The surreal background features a swirling red vortex with several floating white spheres and eyeballs.

stills.title: Pink Alien on Lava Rock
stills.description: A surreal creature with a pink head, large black eyes, and antennae stands on a mossy rock surrounded by flowing orange lava. The background features a swirling red and black vortex with floating white spheres, one of which has red polka dots matching the creature's egg-shaped white body with red spots.

stills.title: Alien Emerging from Wall
stills.description: A vibrant green alien with a large elongated head, one oversized black eye with a red pupil, and blue lips is breaking through a cracked white wall. It has a long neck, dripping red liquid from its mouth, and a bright pink tentacled appendage with fingers resting on a broken rocky ledge.

stills.title: Grim Reaper and Cosmic Octopus
stills.description: A skeletal Grim Reaper in a dark blue hooded robe stands on a wooden boat, gesturing with one hand. A large, bright pink cartoonish octopus with big glossy eyes and a toothy grin sits beside him on the boat, which rests atop a grassy, rocky floating island in a surreal cosmic sky.

stills.title: Cosmic Grim Reaper
stills.description: A skeletal Grim Reaper in a hooded dark robe stands in a wooden Viking-style boat atop a mossy rocky outcrop. A large pink tentacled alien creature with big green eyes hovers beside him, its tentacles draping over the boat and rock, set against a swirling green and blue cosmic vortex sky with stars, clouds, and a glowing spiral galaxy.

stills.title: Skeleton Wizard and Pink Creature
stills.description: A skeletal wizard in a hooded blue robe with pink accents stands with arms outstretched on a moss-covered shipwreck perched atop a rocky outcrop in turbulent waters. A large pink tentacled creature with big black eyes and sharp teeth clings to the bow of the wreck, set against a swirling cosmic vortex of green and purple in a starry night sky.

stills.title: Viking Ghost Ship Over Fields
stills.description: A cloaked figure stands in a Viking longship floating above golden rolling hills at sunset. A massive swirling green and purple cosmic portal with glowing eyes dominates the starry night sky on the left.

stills.title: Swirling Blue Orbs Over Hills
stills.description: A vibrant landscape painting depicts rolling green and golden hills with dark treelines under a dramatic sky. Large blue spheres of varying sizes float throughout a swirling vortex of red, orange, and yellow brushstrokes, with a bright sun visible on the horizon.

stills.title: Surreal Blue Orbs Sunset
stills.description: A vibrant surreal landscape depicts rolling green and golden fields under a dramatic sky filled with swirling orange, red, and yellow patterns. Numerous floating blue spheres of varying sizes, some with thin connecting lines, dominate the upper portion above a distant purple mountain range and a bright setting sun.

stills.title: Blue Poppies in Swirls
stills.description: An abstract painting featuring large, bold blue circular flower forms with visible brushstrokes and green stems. The vibrant background consists of overlapping swirling patterns in yellow, orange, red, and pink, accented with smaller blue dots and circles.

stills.title: Lighthouse on Cliff
stills.description: A striped lighthouse with a glowing orange and yellow beam stands atop a steep green cliff beside a small white keeper's house with a red roof. The dramatic coastal scene includes scattered buildings on the hillside, rocky outcrops, and the ocean visible below under a purple misty sky.

stills.title: Hot Air Balloons in Sky
stills.description: A vibrant scene of numerous colorful hot air balloons floating in a clear blue sky with soft white clouds. The largest balloon is a prominent yellow with orange accents, featuring a wooden basket containing two visible people, surrounded by many smaller balloons in various patterns and hues including purple, red, and striped designs.

stills.title: Rolling Countryside Landscape
stills.description: A vibrant stylized landscape depicts rolling green hills in the foreground, bright yellow fields, a winding blue river, and distant blue mountains under a pale sky. The scene is rendered with bold black outlines and flat areas of color in a graphic illustration style.

stills.title: Desert Valley Landscape
stills.description: A wide desert valley stretches into the distance with rolling orange sand dunes and sparse desert shrubs in the foreground. Layered mountains and rocky cliffs frame a fertile green valley with fields and scattered trees under a bright white sky.

stills.title: Vibrant Blue Orbs
stills.description: An abstract painting featuring numerous circular blue orbs of varying sizes with swirling vortex patterns, set against a dynamic background of swirling brushstrokes in fiery orange, red, pink, and yellow hues. Small blue and black dots are scattered throughout the composition.

stills.title: Surreal Celestial Tower
stills.description: A circular surreal painting depicts a tall ornate clock tower emerging from a green landscape and piercing a large teal planet in the center of a cosmic scene. Colorful spheres, butterflies, and bats orbit the planet against a gradient teal and beige background.

stills.title: Surreal Tower in Sphere
stills.description: A tall ornate clock tower with multiple clock faces stands at the center of a large transparent sphere. The sphere rests on a vibrant patterned mandala in a green rolling hills landscape, with colorful spheres, butterflies, and birds floating around it under a clock-faced halo.

stills.title: Surreal Clock Tower Landscape
stills.description: A massive teal clock tower with a glowing orb base stands at the center of a vibrant green landscape, surrounded by floating colorful spheres, butterflies, and birds. The scene is framed within a large circular portal against a beige background, with a dirt path leading to the tower, rolling hills, standing stones, and a small house in the foreground.

stills.title: Silhouette Eclipse Over City
stills.description: A massive dark silhouette of a woman's head and shoulders dominates the surreal scene, her face eclipsed by a glowing yellow moon. Below, numerous black silhouettes of people stand in a reflective body of water in front of a vibrant city skyline at sunset.

stills.title: Desert Mountain Landscape
stills.description: A hand-drawn landscape illustration shows a vibrant orange desert foreground dotted with black desert shrubs and grasses. Rolling beige and olive hills lead to distant blue mountain peaks under a vast white sky with faint sketch lines.

stills.title: Desert Landscape Painting
stills.description: A minimalist black and white landscape painting featuring a rugged mountain range in the background and a foreground desert plain dotted with yucca and desert shrubs. The upper portion of the canvas shows thick, textured white brushstrokes representing a bright sky.

stills.title: Knight Facing Dragon
stills.description: A knight in full silver armor with a flowing red cape stands on the left, holding a longsword pointed directly into the open mouth of a large purple dragon. The dragon, with orange accents and sharp spines, leans down from the right, its jaws wide around the blade. The background is a vibrant abstract mix of yellow, orange, and purple with paint splatter effects.

stills.title: Monochrome Rolling Hills
stills.description: A black and white landscape painting depicting rolling hills and agricultural fields divided by winding paths and hedgerows. Scattered trees dot the terrain leading to distant layered mountain ranges under a pale sky, with a prominent conical peak visible in the midground.

stills.title: Dog Riding Bicycle
stills.description: A tan and white dog with a black nose sits upright on a bicycle, gripping the chrome handlebars with both front paws while looking off to the left. The realistic digital painting shows the dog positioned on the bike's seat against a simple gradient background with subtle paint splatter effects.

stills.title: Green Sorceress at the Amphitheater
stills.description: A close-up of a stern woman with green skin, long black hair, and glowing white eyes stares directly forward. She wears a dark hooded cloak while standing at the arched entrance of a large outdoor amphitheater filled with an audience watching a performance on a distant stage with red curtains at sunset.

stills.title: Dog at Sunset Concert
stills.description: A large black and brown dog with a collar and tag sits in the foreground amid pink flowers, looking directly at the viewer. Behind the dog, a massive crowd faces a stage under a stone archway with a dramatic sunset, city skyline, and a large yellow sun in the sky.

stills.title: Yellow Labrador in Purple Flowers
stills.description: A close-up portrait of a vibrant yellow Labrador retriever with glossy fur, brown eyes, and a black nose, positioned centrally against a dense background of purple flowers including roses and blossoms.

stills.title: Yellow Labrador in Flowers
stills.description: A vibrant digital painting features a close-up portrait of a yellow Labrador retriever with bright yellow-green fur, floppy ears, and a dark nose, gazing directly at the viewer. The dog is surrounded by a dense background of colorful hibiscus flowers in shades of purple, pink, orange, and yellow.

stills.title: Three Birds in Desert
stills.description: Three large birds stand in a barren desert landscape. A black starry raven on the left, a brown eagle in the center, and a white eagle on the right with a trail of red footprints leading to it.

stills.title: Spell Coffee Spiller
stills.description: Three black crow-like figures stand in a barren landscape. The left crow has 'Spell' written in green on its chest, the middle has 'Coffee' in white, and the right crow is framed in an orange picture frame with 'Spiller' written in white.

stills.title: Three Crows on a Branch
stills.description: Three black crows perch on a thick, weathered wooden branch. The two crows on the left face each other with open beaks as if in conversation, while the third crow on the right looks toward them.

stills.title: Dog at Computer
stills.description: A brown dog wearing a collar sits at a wooden desk, typing on a keyboard with its paws while looking at an Apple iMac monitor. The screen displays the word "coffee" in large orange letters, with a white mug and mouse also visible on the desk.

stills.title: Desert Landscape Vista
stills.description: A stylized desert landscape with rolling golden and orange sand dunes under a pale sky with light blue streaks. In the foreground are dark desert shrubs and grasses, with distant blue mountain ranges visible on the horizon.

stills.title: Dog Riding Bicycle
stills.description: A small corgi-like dog with large upright ears, tan and white fur, and a blue collar with a tag stands on the handlebars of a bicycle. Its front paws rest on the brown grips as it looks directly forward against a textured background.

stills.title: Mountain Valley Ink Sketch
stills.description: A black and white ink drawing of a mountainous landscape with rolling hills in the foreground. The scene features layered mountain ranges with bold black outlines, varying shades of gray wash, and clusters of pine trees on the slopes.

stills.title: Dog Riding Bicycle
stills.description: A light brown dog with floppy ears and a black collar sits upright on a silver bicycle, its front paws resting on the black handlebars as it stares directly at the viewer. The background consists of abstract, painterly brushstrokes in vibrant orange, teal, and purple hues.

stills.title: Three Travelers at Sunset
stills.description: Three robed figures with their backs to the viewer walk along a dirt path through a grassy hillside. The central bearded figure holds a tall wooden staff with a spear-like tip, flanked by two hooded companions each carrying smaller staffs, all heading toward a bright sun setting over distant mountains.

stills.title: Vibrant Split Portrait
stills.description: A close-up digital painting of a woman's face turned slightly to the right. Her skin is rendered in bold orange and peach tones, with striking teal eyes, dark eyebrows, and glossy red lips, set against an abstract background divided into warm orange, green, and cool purple sections with visible brushstrokes.

stills.title: Desert Mesa Landscape
stills.description: A black and white ink drawing of a vast desert canyon landscape. Layered rocky mesas and buttes rise in the background while the foreground features detailed desert shrubs, grasses, and arid terrain under a large empty sky.

stills.title: Dog Typing Spell Coffee
stills.description: A brown and white dog with large ears sits at a desk between two vintage computers. Its front paws rest on a keyboard while a dismembered human foot with red nail polish lies on the desk in front of it. The left monitor displays the text 'Spelll coffee.' in orange letters.

stills.title: Surreal Clock Landscape
stills.description: A large circular wall clock with Roman numerals features a detailed surreal painting in its center showing a stone tower on a green rolling hill with a winding stone path. Various small symbolic objects like butterflies, a bat, pocket watch, Poké Ball, globe, and tools are arranged around the clock face.

stills.title: Surreal Clock Landscape
stills.description: A large circular clock face with Roman numerals features a three-dimensional surreal landscape on its lower half. A green hilly terrain with a winding path, trees, rocks, a frog, and multiple butterflies emerges from the clock, centered around a tower structure with a smaller clock face at its base.

stills.title: Surreal Clock Landscape
stills.description: A large circular clock face with Roman numerals contains a surreal desert scene in its lower half featuring golden sand dunes, a human skull, bats, spiders, and scattered orbs. The upper half shows a blue sky with the Eiffel Tower emerging from a large sphere, a globe, butterflies, birds, and various floating objects.

stills.title: Geometric Abstract Painting
stills.description: An abstract geometric painting featuring overlapping translucent diamonds and polygons in pastel colors. The composition includes the letters P, L, and I integrated into the shapes above a dark horizontal band with reflections below.

stills.title: Abstract Color Blocks
stills.description: An abstract painting featuring large, overlapping blocks and vertical brushstrokes of vibrant color. The composition blends teal, emerald green, deep purple, orange, and lavender with visible texture and paint drips.

stills.title: Vibrant Abstract Landscape
stills.description: An expressive abstract landscape painting featuring a body of reflective water in the foreground with orange and yellow vegetation. Bold orange mountains rise against a dynamic sky of layered blue, white, and peach tones with visible brushstrokes and paint splatters.

stills.title: Vibrant Rural Sunset
stills.description: An expressive landscape painting depicts a dramatic sunset with a sky filled with bold strokes of pink, orange, and yellow. Below, rolling hills in deep blues and blacks overlook golden and green fields dotted with small houses and bushes in the foreground.

stills.title: Orange Abstract Painting
stills.description: An abstract painting dominated by vibrant shades of orange and yellow with dynamic brushstrokes, drips, and scraped textures. Visible elements include white geometric shapes, red circular accents, thin black lines, and handwritten text markings on the right side.

stills.title: Golden Horizon Landscape
stills.description: A vibrant impressionistic landscape at sunset featuring rolling hills and fields in warm orange, red, and yellow tones. The foreground shows abstract structures and green patches under a bright sky with soft white and blue clouds, and a small orange sun sits on the distant horizon.

stills.title: Vibrant Spiral Swirls
stills.description: An abstract painting on a white canvas featuring multiple overlapping spiral forms in various sizes. The composition uses fluid brushstrokes and splatters in shades of pink, purple, and blue with accents of yellow and a small blue dot.

stills.title: Colorful Mediterranean Alley
stills.description: A narrow sunlit alleyway with vibrant yellow and orange buildings lines a steep stone staircase under a clear blue sky. The cobblestone path and steps are adorned with numerous potted plants and flowers in terracotta pots.

stills.title: Colorful Italian Alley
stills.description: A sunlit narrow cobblestone alleyway lined with vibrant yellow and orange Mediterranean buildings featuring arched doorways, blue shutters, and stone steps. The scene is filled with abundant potted plants and hanging baskets overflowing with bright pink and yellow flowers under a clear blue sky.

stills.title: Geometric Abstract Composition
stills.description: A vertical abstract painting featuring bold geometric shapes including orange and black triangles, vertical color blocks in peach, grey, and green, and expressive paint drips. Scattered across the composition are vibrant splashes of pink, yellow, and blue with circular forms and organic brushstrokes against a white background.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny Portrait
stills.description: Bugs Bunny is depicted from the chest up, centered in the frame with his head turned slightly to his right. He has a wide grin showing his teeth, large expressive eyes, long upright ears with pink interiors, and his classic grey and white fur coloring.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny and Friends
stills.description: Three classic Looney Tunes characters stand side by side on a painted floor against a textured backdrop. From left to right are the lanky brown dog with a wide grin, Bugs Bunny in the center with a confident pose, and a grey rabbit wearing a red bow tie striking a suave pose.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny Frenzy
stills.description: A vibrant chaotic scene filled with multiple versions of Bugs Bunny in various costumes and poses, surrounded by colorful fruits, candies, and spheres. The central large Bugs Bunny gives a thumbs-up with one hand and points forward with the other, while smaller Bugs characters appear in the background including one as a wizard and others in dynamic stances.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny and Looney Tunes
stills.description: Bugs Bunny stands confidently in the center with one leg raised and hands clasped, smiling at the viewer. He is surrounded by other Looney Tunes characters including a smaller Bugs Bunny on the left, Yosemite Sam on the right with arms raised, a red-haired girl, and various small creatures and symbols like hearts, butterflies, and TNT boxes on a colorful painted ground.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny and Looney Tunes
stills.description: A large central Bugs Bunny crouches dynamically with clenched fists and a wide grin, surrounded by smaller Looney Tunes characters including Daffy Duck, Tweety, Sylvester, Porky Pig, and others in playful poses. The vibrant composition features colorful brushstrokes, floating balls, and a bright background with dramatic lighting.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny with Eyeball
stills.description: Bugs Bunny stands confidently in the center with one hand on his hip and a wide smile, his large white foot resting on a giant realistic eyeball with a red iris. He is surrounded by multiple smaller versions of himself in various playful poses, some wearing a conductor hat and bow tie, with floating red and green hearts against a blue-green background.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny Spell Tonex
stills.description: Bugs Bunny stands center stage behind a red round table with a lit candle, smiling widely with arms outstretched. He is surrounded by a chaotic crowd of cartoon characters including a man in a teal jacket, a yellow creature with a top hat playing a flute, a white mouse, a blue bird, and various others looking up at him, set against a glowing blue cityscape under a large golden sun with the text SPELL TONEX above.

stills.title: Bugs Bunny with Looney Tunes
stills.description: Bugs Bunny stands confidently at the center with hands on hips, surrounded by several other Looney Tunes characters including Tasmanian Devil, Marvin the Martian, Porky Pig, and Sylvester. The scene is set in a whimsical painted environment with a circus tent, striped ball, and hot air balloon visible.

stills.title: Surreal Clock Landscape
stills.description: A large circular surreal landscape features a prominent clock tower with Roman numerals built into a green rolling hill with a winding stream. The scene is surrounded by floating colorful spheres, butterflies, bats, a star, and a small cross atop the tower, all set against a pale beige background.

stills.title: Surreal Clock Tower Landscape
stills.description: A surreal scene features a large analog clock integrated into a tall stone tower atop a green hill with a winding path. The composition is set within a circular portal against a pale yellow background, surrounded by floating colorful spheres, two butterflies, two bats, a small sun, and floating rock formations.

stills.title: Butterflies and Eyeball Field
stills.description: A surreal landscape depicts a vibrant green grassy field dotted with numerous white spherical eyeballs featuring orange and blue irises. A flock of detailed butterflies with brown, black, and orange patterned wings flies across a pale sky filled with large white clouds above rolling green hills.

stills.title: Oranges and the Mustached Man
stills.description: A bald man with a prominent curled mustache is shown in left profile, head tilted upward with a neutral expression. He is surrounded by a repeating pattern of bright orange fruits with leaves on a solid dark navy background.

stills.title: Bald Man with Mustache
stills.description: A bald man with a prominent handlebar mustache is shown in profile, looking upward with his head tilted back. He wears a dark crew-neck shirt against a simple, dark gradient background.

stills.title: Skeleton's Last Delivery
stills.description: A skeletal figure dressed in a blue suit and fedora stands on a stack of bricks, holding two briefcases. A human skull rests on the bricks in front of him beside a wooden barrel and broken crate, with a gnarled dead tree and a large glowing orange sun in the background.

stills.title: Skull Walker in Vortex
stills.description: A man in a dark suit, trench coat, and fedora stands atop a pile of large stone blocks and human skulls, holding a briefcase. He is positioned in front of a massive swirling vortex of orange and yellow light against a dark background.

stills.title: Cosmic Portal Over Meadow
stills.description: A surreal landscape shows rolling green hills dotted with red poppies in the foreground. In the sky, a large swirling formation of white clouds creates a circular portal revealing a dark space void with a glowing turquoise and gold rim, stars, and small celestial bodies.

stills.title: Surreal Clock Tower Landscape
stills.description: A surreal fantasy landscape features a tall ornate clock tower standing on a winding path that flows like a river through green rolling hills. The scene is framed by a large circular clock-like border with celestial elements above including a starry planet, crescent moon, and floating pumpkins against a teal and golden sky with clouds.

stills.title: Orange Vortex Pattern
stills.description: A repeating pattern of bright oranges and orange slices with green leaves and small flowers arranged around a central dark swirling vortex on a deep navy blue background.

stills.title: Cosmic Black Hole
stills.description: A large circular formation dominates the center of the image, featuring concentric rings that transition from bright white-blue at the core to darker blue and black toward the outer edges. The surrounding dark space contains scattered specks of white and orange dots, with visible brushstroke textures and paint drips throughout.

stills.title: Cosmic Black Hole Rift
stills.description: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a large black hole with a jagged, torn blue-white event horizon at the center. Swirling rings of dark matter and multiple metallic blue spheres orbit around it against a starry dark space background with nebulae and light streaks.

stills.title: Shadowed Mirror Selfie
stills.description: A man with dark hair and beard holds a black smartphone in his right hand, partially obscuring the right side of his face as he takes a selfie. The composition is framed as a small, brightly lit rectangular image centered within a vast, textured black void.

stills.title: Framed Shadow Portrait
stills.description: A man with short dark hair and a serious expression stares directly forward from within a thin, illuminated rectangular frame. He holds a small dark object between his fingers near the right side of his face, set against a completely black background.

stills.title: Mirror Selfie in Darkness
stills.description: A bearded man with short dark hair stands centered in a dark rectangular doorway or mirror frame, holding a smartphone in his right hand to take a selfie. The scene is dimly lit with a faint glow outlining the frame against deep shadows, and a wooden floor is visible at the bottom.

stills.title: Shadowed Figure with Phone
stills.description: A mysterious figure stands in complete darkness, holding a black smartphone with both hands to completely obscure their face. The hands have long, manicured nails with red tips, emerging from a dark garment against a glowing, irregular red rectangular frame that has a dripping, molten texture.

stills.title: Framed Digital Portrait
stills.description: A painted depiction of a black smartphone with a colorful, textured frame containing a portrait of a bearded man in a dark hoodie standing against a teal background. The entire composition is set against a dark backdrop with visible brushstrokes and paint drips.

stills.title: Man in Mirror
stills.description: A surreal painting viewed through a dark doorway or frame. In the center of a deep blue-black wall hangs a small framed portrait of a young man with light brown hair taking a selfie with a smartphone, his reflection visible within the picture.

stills.title: Checkered Path to Abyss
stills.description: A surreal painting depicts a black and white checkered floor leading into a misty blue forest of twisted, leafless trees. Dramatic red and black abstract structures tower on the left while a gnarled purple tree and a small leaping figure appear on the right.

stills.title: Majestic Forest Stag
stills.description: A majestic brown stag with large, detailed antlers stands centered and facing forward in a forest clearing. The scene is framed within a dark wooden picture frame with a metallic inner border, resting on a surface with a small paint smear at the bottom.

stills.description: A green-skinned sorceress in a flowing purple robe and ornate headdress stands on a broken stone bridge, holding a small red mouse in her hand. Above her, a giant stylized eye with a pink iris and mechanical segments floats in a swirling purple and orange cosmic sky filled with clouds, floating temples, cherry blossoms, and glowing orbs.
